status_vocabulary.agreed: Direction explicitly requested by the user; feasibility is not implied.
status_vocabulary.proposed: Candidate pending feasibility and evaluation; this is not a standing user-approval requirement.

subhourly_candidate.gate: Real subhourly observations and meaningful target coverage; no upsampling hourly rows.

context.minimum_valid_context_decision: Specify per modality after auditing available windows and quality; before model comparison.
context.selection: Audit all candidate contexts, then compare only a small feasible shortlist.

time_contract.origin: Completed bin right edge t; all input information available by t.
time_contract.model_snapshot_constraint: Model fit, preprocessing and checkpoint selection must exist by origin.
time_contract.missing_availability_policy: Declare dataset-specific assumptions; do not silently equate event time and availability.

input_aggregation.native_hourly_aggregate_policy: Use published hourly value and its semantics; do not invent intrahour min/max.

target_definition.published_value_policy: Preserve source acquisition/statistic semantics; do not assume hourly row is a raw-data mean.
target_definition.no_observations_policy: Mask target as absent; never interpolate evaluation labels.
target_definition.coverage_rule_decision: Define by variable and acquisition method after cadence/count audit and before comparison.
target_definition.quantiles_describe: Conditional distribution of chosen future target, not within-bin empirical percentiles.

multirate_architecture.fast_view: Completed hourly bins initially, category encoders and causal temporal memory.
multirate_architecture.slow_view: Actual laboratory events with true times, availability, masks and ages; separate context if justified.
multirate_architecture.shared_latent: Same latent width with modality/view metadata; no forced resampling into new measurements.
multirate_architecture.query_readout_candidate: Target/horizon query cross-attends permitted fast and slow memories.
multirate_architecture.simple_reference: Last available lab value plus explicit age and missingness.

reduction_decision.implemented_per_target_semantics: Equal weight per observed scalar target at a sample and horizon.
reduction_decision.not_implemented_candidate: Mean within each target-horizon cell, then average active cells; optionally balance heads.
reduction_decision.rare_cell_policy: Set support requirements or weights using training/development before test.

architecture_comparison.strategy: Sequential ablations; one architectural hypothesis at a time; no Cartesian grid.

stage_3_fusion.gate: Adequate coobserved groups and a defensible temporal candidate.

stage_4_time.gate: Sufficient effective sequence length or meaningful irregularity; assess 24 actual hourly tokens and later 96 only if real subhourly data.

transfer.static_external: NHANES for masked reconstruction of compatible lab encoders; no temporal trajectories.
transfer.hourly_external: Real hourly clinical sequences for temporal pretraining; evaluate within source domain separately.
transfer.space_adaptation: Harmonized space labels and sufficient target cadence required for hourly flight evaluation.
transfer.comparison: From-scratch vs external-pretrained on identical reserved target-domain subjects.

evaluation.partitions: Specify person/episode/domain generalization and chronological model availability before running; separate development/calibration/test as support permits.

dashboard.truth_source: Persisted out-of-sample predictions and quality metadata, not fabricated continuous labels.

feasibility_gates: Confirm native sampling cadence, time semantics and availability per source.
Count usable contexts and real labels at 1/4/8/24h by target, head, person, episode and domain.
Verify identity and episode linkage; separate subjects before fitting transformations.
Define input eligibility, target interval and variable-specific coverage rules.
Freeze evaluation and small architecture shortlist before training.
Do not claim hourly space performance without real hourly space target support.
